note: Forbidden: with the notify exchanged and signature authentication in use, emitting a legacy AUTH method (1 RSA, 3 DSS) instead of Digital Signature (14). TestRFC7427DigitalSignatureMethodIsUsed asserts auth.AuthMethod == wire.AuthMethodDigitalSig with RemoteHashAlgos set (red on any other method) and, as the negative, that with no notify received computeX509Auth returns an error and a nil payload rather than falling back to a legacy method.
